title: Tandoori haddock with sweet potato
summary: Tandoori haddock with sweet potato is a indian dinner built around haddock fillets and sweet potatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat haddock fillets dry and season it. Prep sweet potatoes and tandoori masala for Tandoori haddock with sweet potato so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook haddock fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook sweet potatoes and tandoori masala in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Tandoori haddock with sweet potato before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice haddock fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Check that the sweet potato is tender, then serve.
